color.note: Figma defines light mode only; ShifaTheme has no dark scheme. Semantic tokens alias the primitives, named 1:1 after Figma semantic/color/<group>/<name> (ShifaColors.<Group>.<Name> in code).

tokens.name: teal-50
tokens.usage: Shifa teal, the brand primitive. Read through the semantic tokens (text-brand, bg-brand, interactive-primary…), never directly.

tokens.name: charcoal
tokens.usage: Primary ink primitive.

tokens.name: grey-600
tokens.usage: Secondary ink primitive.

tokens.name: grey-500
tokens.usage: Tertiary ink primitive.

tokens.name: grey-400
tokens.usage: Disabled ink and disabled border primitive.

tokens.name: grey-200
tokens.usage: Hairline and disabled fill primitive.

tokens.name: grey-100
tokens.usage: Canvas primitive.

tokens.name: white
tokens.usage: Surface and inverse ink primitive.

tokens.name: red
tokens.usage: Error primitive.

tokens.name: amber
tokens.usage: Warning primitive (also star ratings).

tokens.name: blue
tokens.usage: Info primitive.

tokens.name: text-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, body copy and input values on bg-surface (14.9:1) and bg-canvas (13.4:1).

tokens.name: text-secondary
tokens.usage: Supporting copy on bg-surface (8.6:1) and bg-canvas (7.7:1).

tokens.name: text-tertiary
tokens.usage: Placeholders, floating labels, timestamps, meta. 3.9:1 on bg-surface and 3.5:1 on bg-canvas: below 4.5:1 at these 10–14px sizes. Kept exact from source; flagged.

tokens.name: text-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled labels and placeholders. Exempt from contrast as inactive UI (2.8:1 on surface).

tokens.name: text-inverse
tokens.usage: Labels on interactive-primary and destructive fills. 2.4:1 on teal (fails AA), 4.7:1 on red. Kept exact from source; flagged.

tokens.name: text-brand
tokens.usage: Secondary/tertiary button labels, selected chips and nav tab, unread times, links. 2.4:1 on bg-surface: fails AA for text. Kept exact from source; flagged.

tokens.name: text-link
tokens.usage: Inline links. Same contrast caveat as text-brand.

tokens.name: text-error
tokens.usage: Error helper text and destructive labels on bg-surface (4.7:1) and bg-error-subtle (4.0:1).

tokens.name: text-warning
tokens.usage: Tertiary tag label on bg-warning-subtle (2.0:1: fails AA). Kept exact from source; flagged.

tokens.name: text-info
tokens.usage: Secondary (default) tag label on bg-info-subtle (4.1:1) and info copy on bg-surface (4.7:1).

tokens.name: icon-primary
tokens.usage: Default icon tint on bg-surface and bg-canvas.

tokens.name: icon-secondary
tokens.usage: Clear (×) buttons, dropdown chevrons, filled search glass.

tokens.name: icon-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled icons, empty search glass, switch track when off.

tokens.name: icon-inverse
tokens.usage: Icons on teal, red and dark fills; switch knob.

tokens.name: icon-brand
tokens.usage: Selected nav icon, mic while recording, switch track when on, notification bubble fill, success status. 2.4:1 on white: below the 3:1 icon floor. Kept exact; flagged.

tokens.name: icon-error
tokens.usage: Error status and destructive icons.

tokens.name: icon-warning
tokens.usage: Filled rating stars and warning status (2.1:1 on white; flagged).

tokens.name: icon-info
tokens.usage: Info status icons.

tokens.name: bg-canvas
tokens.usage: Page background; also the fill of secondary action/icon buttons and unselected chips.

tokens.name: bg-surface
tokens.usage: Cards, inputs, trays, pop-ups, page headers.

tokens.name: bg-disabled
tokens.usage: Disabled inputs and fields.

tokens.name: bg-brand
tokens.usage: Brand blocks: splash, login hero.

tokens.name: bg-success-subtle
tokens.usage: Primary tag, selected filter chip, success banner and status disc.

tokens.name: bg-warning-subtle
tokens.usage: Tertiary tag, warning banner, feedback notification, pending status disc.

tokens.name: bg-error-subtle
tokens.usage: Error banner and failed status disc.

tokens.name: bg-info-subtle
tokens.usage: Secondary (default) tag.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Scrim behind trays and pop-ups.

tokens.name: border-default
tokens.usage: Input, dropdown, search and chat-bar outline at rest (2px).

tokens.name: border-disabled
tokens.usage: Outline of disabled inputs and secondary buttons.

tokens.name: border-brand
tokens.usage: Secondary button outline; card-on-white section outline.

tokens.name: border-focus
tokens.usage: Focused input / search / chat-bar outline, selected chip ring, text cursor.

tokens.name: border-error
tokens.usage: Errored input outline; destructive secondary button; error banner.

tokens.name: border-warning
tokens.usage: Warning banner and feedback notification outline.

tokens.name: border-success
tokens.usage: Success banner outline.

tokens.name: interactive-primary
tokens.usage: Primary button, action button, icon button, selected slot chip fill.

tokens.name: interactive-on-primary
tokens.usage: Label and icon on interactive-primary and interactive-destructive (see text-inverse for contrast).

tokens.name: interactive-disabled-bg
tokens.usage: Fill of disabled primary / action / icon buttons.

tokens.name: interactive-destructive
tokens.usage: Destructive primary / action / icon button fill.

tokens.name: alpha-white-70
tokens.usage: Nav bar fill (frosted pill).

tokens.name: alpha-white-90
tokens.usage: Card-on-color section fill.

tokens.name: alpha-teal-75
tokens.usage: Teal overlay at 75%.

tokens.name: alpha-teal-25
tokens.usage: Received chat bubble (doctor or Shifa AI).

tokens.name: alpha-teal-15
tokens.usage: Card-on-white section fill.

tokens.name: alpha-black-5
tokens.usage: Sent chat bubble (the patient).

tokens.name: alpha-black-50
tokens.usage: Black at 50%.

tokens.name: bg-hover
tokens.usage: Hover on rows, nav items, menu items and conversations (web pointer only).

tokens.name: bg-selected
tokens.usage: Selected nav item, table row and conversation. Pair with Bold text-primary, not teal text.

tokens.name: chart-1
tokens.usage: Primary data series (clinic visits, revenue). Label line ends directly.

tokens.name: chart-2
tokens.usage: Comparison series (video visits, last period). Also dashed, so it reads without colour.

tokens.name: chart-3
tokens.usage: Third series (follow-ups, overdue).

tokens.name: chart-4
tokens.usage: Fourth series.

tokens.name: chart-grid
tokens.usage: Chart grid lines and donut track.

tokens.name: raw-splash-blob
tokens.usage: Splash screen blobs (teal at 65% under a 25% black grain, baked to its average).

tokens.name: raw-splash-logo
tokens.usage: Splash logo tint.

tokens.name: raw-glass-tile
tokens.usage: Glass tile behind the logo on splash and login hero, with a white 1px border.

styles.name: headline-large
styles.usage: MaterialTheme.typography.headlineLarge: main tab title in the page header.

styles.name: body-large
styles.usage: bodyLarge: input value and placeholder, dropdown options.

styles.name: label-large
styles.usage: labelLarge: primary / secondary / tertiary button label.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: ShifaTextStyles.caption: floating input label, helper text, chat time; nav tab label at Medium (Bold when selected).

styles.name: chat-input
styles.usage: chatInput: chat-bar and search-field value and placeholder.

styles.name: profile-name
styles.usage: profileName: profile name; doctor, appointment and notification titles.

styles.name: tray-title
styles.usage: trayTitle: tray and pop-up title, centred.

styles.name: chat-message
styles.sample: Take with food, twice a day.

styles.name: notification-body
styles.usage: notificationBody: notification body, two lines max.

styles.name: table-head
styles.usage: DataTable header cells, text-secondary, never uppercase.

styles.name: table-cell
styles.usage: DataTable cells; Bold for the first (person) column.

styles.name: nav-item
styles.usage: Sidebar nav label; Bold when selected.

styles.name: body-text
styles.sample: Headache since morning, worse when standing.
styles.usage: Multi-line reading text: consultation notes, AI answers, dialog bodies.

spacing.note: Figma semantic/space/*. Inset = padding, gap = between siblings in a row, stack = between siblings in a column (ShifaSpacing.Inset|Gap|Stack).

tokens.name: inset-xs
tokens.usage: Action-button vertical padding, input vertical padding, icon-only action button.

tokens.name: inset-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, cards, banners, search field, input horizontal padding.

tokens.name: inset-md
tokens.usage: Screen gutter, sections, trays, chat-bar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: inset-lg
tokens.usage: Nav bar horizontal padding.

tokens.name: gap-xs
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label in pills and meta rows; carousel of chips.

tokens.name: gap-sm
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label in buttons; card content rows; chip grid.

tokens.name: gap-md
tokens.usage: Section header to content; avatar to text in cards; header actions.

tokens.name: gap-lg
tokens.usage: Wide row gaps.

tokens.name: stack-xs
tokens.usage: Bubble to its time; notification bubble padding.

tokens.name: stack-sm
tokens.usage: Tag and chip vertical padding; chip grid rows.

tokens.name: stack-md
tokens.usage: Tray vertical padding; chat bubble vertical padding.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Small elements; image inside a chat bubble.

tokens.name: radius-control-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, dropdowns, cards, banners, notifications.

tokens.name: radius-control-lg
tokens.usage: Sections, images, chat bubbles (one corner square at the sender's side).

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Trays (top corners only) and pop-ups.

tokens.name: radius-full
tokens.usage: Tags, chips, action and icon buttons, search field, chat bar, nav bar, avatars.

shadow.note: Figma drop-shadow effect styles, spread 0, applied with Modifier.dropShadow(shape, ShifaShadow.X).

tokens.name: shadow-default
tokens.usage: Primary, secondary and icon buttons.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards on bg-canvas; dropped on full-page lists.

tokens.name: shadow-tray
tokens.usage: Trays and pop-ups.

tokens.name: shadow-dropdown
tokens.usage: Expanded dropdown.

tokens.name: shadow-section
tokens.usage: A section inside a section.

tokens.name: shadow-nav-bar
tokens.usage: Floating nav bar.

tokens.name: size-4

tokens.name: size-6

tokens.name: size-8
tokens.usage: Small spacers.

tokens.name: size-12

tokens.name: size-14

tokens.name: size-16

tokens.name: size-20
tokens.usage: 20px icons.

tokens.name: size-22
tokens.usage: Switch height; notification title bar.

tokens.name: size-24
tokens.usage: Doctor card verified badge (full).

tokens.name: size-26

tokens.name: size-28

tokens.name: size-30
tokens.usage: Input inner content height.

tokens.name: size-36
tokens.usage: Mid controls.

breakpoint.note: Doctor app viewport breakpoints (web-flutter-doctor core/layout/responsive.dart). Components respond to their container width.

tokens.name: breakpoint-split-pane
tokens.usage: Content width below which master-detail splits, tables and headers stack to one column.

tokens.name: breakpoint-mobile
tokens.usage: Below this, phone browsers and native apps use the bottom NavBar instead of a sidebar.

tokens.name: breakpoint-tablet
tokens.usage: Content width below which toolbars compact and KPI grids go two across.

tokens.name: breakpoint-sidebar
tokens.usage: Viewport width from which the full labelled sidebar shows; 768–1100 uses the icon rail.

layout.note: Fixed layout widths in the doctor workspace.

tokens.name: layout-sidebar
tokens.usage: Full labelled sidebar (web ≥ breakpoint-sidebar).

tokens.name: layout-sidebar-compact
tokens.usage: Icon rail sidebar (tablet, narrow laptop).

tokens.name: layout-dialog-max
tokens.usage: Max width of a ResponsiveDialog and a Toast on web.

tokens.name: layout-list-pane
tokens.usage: List pane of a list-and-detail split (chat, patients).
